evidence.title: California Democrats demand Trump apology for rally remarks

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's public statements and 2028 campaign activity
occurrences.quote_span: The governor, who is weighing a 2028 presidential run, previously told The Hill that Trump is “mentally ill” and called for invoking the 25th Amendment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's public statements responding to Trump's Iran remarks
occurrences.quote_span: Trump’s words also inflamed California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D), who called the rhetoric “deranged and dangerous,” later adding that the comments were “dangerous –– if not treasonous” for suggesting the cities could be attacked.
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

evidence.title: Newsom calls for 25th Amendment after Trump’s remarks on California

occurrences.checkable_against: Steven Cheung's October 6, 2026 post on X
occurrences.quote_span: “He was clearly stating U.S. cities would have been threatened if a nuclear Iran hadn’t been stopped. America is safer because of the President. Iran has no nuclear, no navy, no air force, and no money,” Cheung wrote on social platform X.
occurrences.speaker: Steven Cheung
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Matthew Klink's statement about Trump's October 5, 2026 remarks
occurrences.quote_span: “Last night, apparently, the feeling became mutual,” he added.
occurrences.speaker: Matthew Klink
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Garry South's statement about Gavin Newsom's response
occurrences.quote_span: Garry South, a Democratic strategist based in California and a former adviser to Newsom, said the California governor was “right on” to call out Trump for “suggesting a foreign adversary target cities in his state.”
occurrences.speaker: Garry South
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Rob Stutzman's statement about Republican candidates' responses to Trump's October 5, 2026 rally
occurrences.quote_span: “He goes to Nebraska last night to rally the base, but the storyline of it will be Republican candidates in difficult races needing to once again distance themselves from the president,” said Rob Stutzman, a veteran California Republican strategist.
occurrences.speaker: Rob Stutzman
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Steven Cheung's October 6, 2026 social media statement
occurrences.quote_span: Steven Cheung, the White House’s communications director, said on social media that the “media freakout” over the comments “is not rooted in reality.”
occurrences.speaker: Steven Cheung
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Garry South's statement about Trump's remarks and the Iranian-American population in Los Angeles
occurrences.quote_span: “Los Angeles is home to the largest expatriate Iranian community outside of Iran, not that ignoramus Trump probably knows that, but it makes it doubly egregious to put an Iranian target on Southern California,” South said.
occurrences.speaker: Garry South
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's October 6, 2026 public statement
occurrences.quote_span: “TIME FOR THE 25TH!” the governor said in a statement.
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Joel Payne's statement about Gavin Newsom's response
occurrences.quote_span: “Good for Gavin, as he should,” said Democratic strategist Joel Payne.
occurrences.speaker: Joel Payne
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Statements by Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass and San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria responding to Trump's remarks
occurrences.quote_span: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass (D) said Trump’s remarks are “dangerous and could potentially compromise our safety,” while San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria (D) told Trump in his own statement to “keep our city out of your reckless war talk.”
occurrences.speaker: Karen Bass and Todd Gloria
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Jim Desmond's public statement responding to Donald Trump's remarks

occurrences.checkable_against: The Hill interview with Gavin Newsom on October 6, 2026

occurrences.quote_span: Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass (D) said Trump’s remarks are “dangerous and could potentially compromise our safety,” while San Diego Mayor Todd Gloria (D) told Trump in his own statement to “keep our city out of your reckless war talk.”

occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's October 5, 2026 social media post
occurrences.quote_span: The sentiment follows a social media post from Newsom on Monday where he called Trump “deranged and dangerous.”
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Rob Stutzman's statement about Donald Trump's campaign effects
occurrences.quote_span: “One of the biggest problems Republicans are facing is that the president of their party is unhinged,” Stutzman said. “He is being extremely counterproductive on the road to Republican political objectives.”

occurrences.checkable_against: Joel Payne's statement about Donald Trump's conduct
occurrences.quote_span: “Few people in modern American history have tried to turn the country against each other or use the bully pulpit of the presidency to turn people against each other more than Donald Trump.”

occurrences.subject: Gavin Newsom's call for invoking the 25th Amendment against Donald Trump

occurrences.checkable_against: Matthew Klink's statement about Trump's October 5, 2026 remarks
occurrences.quote_span: “While the president’s statement may get laughs in Nebraska, in California it highlights why our state’s voters passionately dislike Trump,” said Matthew Klink, a California-based Republican strategist.

occurrences.checkable_against: Davis Ingle's White House statement responding to Gavin Newsom on October 6, 2026

occurrences.checkable_against: Jim Desmond's October 6, 2026 social media post

occurrences.speaker: Jim Desmond
